$Comment: A bramble knot that keeps one Blight spawn marker alive: the SpawnMarkerBlock component below stands the KweebecNightmare_Blight_Marker entity two blocks above wherever this block is placed, and the Warden encounter script fires those markers with each phase's wave of adds. The round stamps four of these around the Heartwood Gate from the KweebecNightmare/Warden_Spawners prefab; stamp more to raise the cap on live adds, or place them by hand to shape where the adds rise. The marker floats two blocks up rather than one so a block that landed a step below the rolling ground still puts its marker in open air. No Gathering group and no Support rule, so nobody can harvest it away and it never pops off uneven ground.
